'''Bonagal''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. Located within the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], Bonagal occupied the seventh [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Mandalore (star)/Legends|Mandalore]], between the orbits of [[Mandallia]] and [[Shukut/Legends|Shukut]]. A [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], Bonagal was surrounded by thirty-four [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] forces of [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]] journeyed from [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] to conquer the uninhabited planet that became [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="TEA" /> the newly renamed [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] spread out to conquer the worlds of the surrounding system,<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> including Bonagal.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bonagal was first introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2009]] reference book, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].
